# BB00478: Ziyarat for the last [to believe] {.unnumbered}

Visitation for the last [to ascend]

Then recite what hath been sent down by God in His remembrance, for verily He is the Remembrance, the Manifest, the Inaccessible, the Exalted, the Great.

May there be upon thee from the Glory of God its most glorious, and from the Majesty of God its most majestic, and from the Beauty of God its most beautiful, and from the Grandeur of God its most grand, and from the Light of God its most luminous, and from the Mercy of God its most expansive, and from the Words of God their most perfect, and from the Names of God their most great, and from the Might of God its mightiest, and from the Will of God its most conclusive, and from the Knowledge of God its most penetrating, and from the Power of God its most potent, and from the Utterance of God its most pleasing, and from the Honor of God its most honorable, and from the Sovereignty of God its most enduring, and from the Dominion of God its most glorious, and from the Loftiness of God its most elevated, and from the Favor of God its most ancient, and from every good thing that hath no equal, no peer, no associate, no likeness, and no similitude, unto thee, through thee, from thee, towards thee, and upon thee.

How great is thy right in creation and how manifest thy station in invention! Ever doth the ocean of omnipotence surge with thy conquering power, and the sea of almightiness boil with thy overwhelming might. God shall take vengeance on those who know thee not, and God shall aid those who uphold thy right. Nothing whatsoever in the heavens or on earth or in all that lieth between them can be hidden from His knowledge, nor can anything in the kingdom of command or creation or whatsoever lieth beneath them render Him powerless. He createth what He willeth through His command; verily He hath power over all things.

And thou shalt mention all the primary names, then the names which have been established under the shadow of thy self, according to what thou hast heard before from the Book of God and what thou hearest at that time from the Tongue of God, for this is a bounty that nothing in the heavens or on earth or in all that lieth between them can equal. Thus doth God bestow His favor upon thee and upon whomsoever He willeth among His creation. Verily, He is the Possessor of great bounty.

The verses which were revealed on the Day of ʿArafat
